known_issues: SQLite store uses synchronous sqlite3 wrapped in async methods — not migrated to aiosqlite
Gradio demo uses sync-to-async ThreadPoolExecutor workaround
MediaPipe Pose uses legacy mp.solutions.pose API (not the new Tasks API)
LanceDB vector store requires separate install (pip install baymax[vector])
Semantic fact extraction uses simple keyword heuristics (not LLM-based)
Wake phrase gate uses ASR transcript matching — NOT equivalent to production wake-word model
OpenCV imshow overlay will fail silently on headless machines — expected and handled gracefully
PortAudio may not be installed on headless machines (required for TTS audio playback)
Piper TTS backend is a placeholder — not yet fully implemented
MediaPipe not installed in current environment — runtime falls back to null affect backend gracefully
Companion UI requires npm and Node.js to be installed
Realtime voice path requires OPENAI_API_KEY and network connectivity; local chained mode is default
